items.title: The new TONE3000 is FREE and provides access to countless NAM profiles
items.excerpt: TONE3000 has released a free plugin for macOS, Windows and Linux that plays back Neural Amp Modeler (NAM) captures, opening a huge library of neural-modelled amps, cabs, pedals and outboard to any DAW. Neural capture is quietly becoming the default way guitar and studio gear gets emulated — sound and reactive behaviour, not just static impulse responses.

items.title: Elastic Melody now does bass and DFAM-style percussion, too (Mac, iOS)
items.excerpt: Elastic Melody, a go-to algorithmic melody generator for Mac, iPad and iPhone, adds Pitch and Filter Drive modes so the same generative engine can now write basslines and DFAM-style percussion. It is a case study in generative composition as an instrument rather than a prompt box.

items.title: Logic Pro 12.3, as reviewed by a Cubase version 1 user
items.excerpt: A lifelong Cubase user reviews Logic Pro 12.3 and lands on its AI features as the reason to switch: Session Players that conjure convincing bass, drum and keyboard parts from a project's chords and groove, plus "one of the best stem separation processes I've encountered". A concrete read on how AI performers reshape a DAW workflow.
items.keyword: AI in Logic Pro / Session Players

items.title: Report explores AI’s indies impact and infrastructure erosion
items.excerpt: Research firm Stvdio and Secretly Distribution published a report on the independent-music sector, framed as "a fight for music's infrastructure" as generative AI floods catalogues and recommendation systems. It maps what erodes for working artists when supply becomes infinite.

items.title: Meet the Musicians Leading the Anti-AI ‘Callout Culture’
items.excerpt: A profile of the musicians hunting down AI "grifters" passing off generated tracks as human work, and the norms they are improvising in public. A look at how craft communities police authorship when the tooling leaves no fingerprints.

items.title: AI models can identify iconic jazz pianists based on their recordings, while also revealing their "musical fingerprints"
items.excerpt: New research shows machine-learning models can name the jazz pianist behind a recording and, in doing so, expose the measurable "musical fingerprint" of a player's touch, timing and voicing. Researchers say it could suggest authors for unattributed works.

items.title: Mark My Words: AI Music Is the End of the Artist Economy.
items.excerpt: People keep calling gen-AI music "inevitable", but if making a song no longer requires an artist, the argument goes, that isn't the future — it's the end of the artist economy. A blunt counter-case to the tooling optimism.

items.title: Universal Music JV Licenses 24+ AI Patents to Udio and GRAI
items.excerpt: Universal Music has licensed more than two dozen AI patents to Udio and GRAI through 'Music IP Holdings', its JV with Liquidax — turning the major label into a patent licensor for the generative-music stack, not just a rights holder suing it.

items.title: Lucinate video synth animates and live-codes visuals on Mac and iOS
items.excerpt: From the makers of AUM, Lucinate is a real-time Metal-based visual environment for macOS and iOS that works as a ready-to-play, Ableton Link-synced video synth and opens up to live coding. A generative visualizer pipeline for musicians who don't want to render a music video.

items.title: Yamaha Creator Pass Review: A Subscription Built For The Budding Bedroom Producer
items.excerpt: Yamaha's first real software play bundles Output, LANDR AI mastering, Cubase 15 AI and Ableton Live 12 Lite into a monthly subscription for beginner producers. AI tooling is quietly becoming the entry-level default rather than an add-on purchase.

items.title: Soundplate acquires AI music-mastering company Stemmer
items.excerpt: Soundplate, which builds marketing tools for independent artists, has bought AI mastering service Stemmer, folding automated mastering into an indie-artist toolkit rather than leaving it as a standalone service.

items.title: The best new music plugins this week, free and paid
items.excerpt: MusicTech's weekly sweep of new instruments, effects and mixing plugins for Ableton Live, Logic Pro and other DAWs — useful as a running index of which releases lean on machine-learning processing this week.
